title: Flash fantasies
intro:
Four Flash Fantasies reimagined through wider, locked-off compositions - simpler, stiller, more psychologically charged images that reveal a deeper layer of Garbo’s emotional experience.

Consider further where these moments come in, whether they can perhaps punctuate sections and chapters.

scenes.title: SCULPTING
scenes.note: The sculpting fantasy feels tonally different from those before and after it. Consider reimagining it through a single, locked-off, wide composition — something more simple, refined and psychologically charged than the current close-up approach.  Suggestions below.
scenes.setNote: BROAD VISUAL REFERENCES – APPROACH - WIDE, LOCKED-OFF

shots.title: A CONTORTED GARBO IN A SPARSE, UNDEFINED SPACE
shots.text: A wide, locked-off composition of Garbo, her body held completely still in an unnatural, sculptural contortion. Wide locked off.

shots.title: A solitary contorted sculpture
shots.text: A single, distorted sculptural figure, motionless in a vast, non-specific space. Wide locked off.

shots.title: Garbo as a living sculpture among sculptures
shots.text: A wide, locked-off composition of Garbo standing motionless among sculptural forms in a studio-like space, her body almost indistinguishable from the sculptures surrounding her. Wide locked off.

shots.title: Garbo covered in wet clay
shots.text: Slowly pushing it back from her hair as it begins to set and harden. Locked off

scenes.title: Isolation
scenes.note: The Mimi kiss may be unnecessary here. Perhaps this section could instead explore Garbo’s isolation, building on the bold, poetic visual language of the earlier fantasies through wider, evocative compositions. Aim for simple yet powerful, surreal and psychologically charged imagery that reveals a deeper layer of her emotional experience. Re-consider further where these moments come in to punctuate the chapter.
scenes.setNote: BROAD VISUAL REFERENCES – APPROACH - WIDE, LOCKED-OFF

shots.title: A Solitary in a wide composition built around negative space
shots.text: Garbo, a solitary figure within an austere, vast, frame. The scale, silence, and distance of the environment convey as much emotion as her presence within the frame.

shots.title: Trapped in a marsh
shots.text: Garbo alone in a vast, waterlogged landscape, struggling to pull herself through the marsh. Her movements are slow and laboured against the stillness of the surrounding environment. (nod to Torrent)

shots.title: Pulled by hands
shots.text: Garbo seated, her body slowly lifted from the chair by hands. The force pulls her upward, with no other recognizable faces in the frame. Static composition.

scenes.title: UNTETHERED
scenes.note: Consider reimagining this moment through wider, single take, compositions - oneiric, psychologically charged.
scenes.setNote: BROAD VISUAL REFERENCES - APPROACH - WIDE, LOCKED-OFF

shots.title: Young Mimi performing before a fire in sweden
shots.text: A wide, still image of a young Mimi performing alone in front of a fire in  - silent. Still wide locked off.

shots.title: Garbo watching Mimi float behind her
shots.text: A wide, still image from behind Garbo’s in an old Stockholm street, Mimi suspended or drifting behind her, either untethered or connected by a rope. An oneiric image of attachment, distance and memory. Locked off wide.

shots.title: Young Garbo and young Mimi running across a landscape
shots.text: The two run together through an open landscape in Sweden, until Garbo gradually peels away and Mimi continues running on alone.  Wide tracking shot.

shots.title: MIMI INFRONT OF RAVAGING WAVES
shots.text: Mimi alone in front of violent waves, small against the scale of the sea.

shots.title: Wind violent wind between Garbo and Mimi
shots.text: Garbo and Mimi held apart in a wide frame in Stockholm, a violent wind moving past them.  Wide, locked off  composition.

scenes.title: Letting Go of Identity
scenes.note: Consider removing the current flash fantasy — the mirror maze, explanatory V.O. and younger-self flashback. The themes of masks are already beautifully woven throughout the film. Perhaps reimagine this moment through something more surreal, simple and evocative, using wider, compositions. Imagery of fire, water, wind or physical destruction could capture the dissolution of identity.
scenes.setNote: BROAD VISUAL REFERENCES BELOW - APPROACH - WIDE, LOCKED-OFF

shots.title: OLD HOUSE CRUMBLING FROM WITHIN
shots.text: A wide, locked-off composition inside an old house. The walls cracked, plaster falls from the ceiling - perhaps  water tears through the room

shots.title: Hands holding flames
shots.text: A simple, sustained image of hands holding fire, flames slowly growing or moving across the palms.

shots.title: Garbo surrounded by embers
shots.text: A wide, locked-off image of Garbo standing still in a vast frame as glowing embers and ash fill the air around her.

shots.title: Flames floating on water
shots.text: A expanse of dark water, with flames moving across the surface of the waves.

shots.title: GARBO BEFORE A WALL OF FIRE
shots.text: Garbo stands silhouetted, motionless before an immense wall of flames. She drops backwards (toward us)

shots.title: BARN FIRE.
shots.text: A wide, locked-off image of Garbo standing still, watching a structure engulfed in flames

shots.title: GARBO - A SOLITARY PORTRAIT
shots.text: Garbo alone, her expression distant and introspective, as light spins around her, evoking a profound sense of knowing.
